tasks_completed.description: Created fileContentReader.ts utility for reading file content on tool-call-end (CLI)
tasks_completed.rationale: CLI needs to read the file after Edit/Write tools complete and inject the content into the tool-call-end envelope so the app can display it

tasks_completed.description: Modified sessionProtocolMapper.ts to track tool_use blocks and enrich tool-call-end output with file content
tasks_completed.changes: Added toolUseMap to ClaudeSessionProtocolState, enrichToolResultOutput() function that replaces tool-call-end output with file content for Edit/Write tools
tasks_completed.rationale: The mapper processes Claude SDK output and needs to inject file content into the tool-call-end envelope before it reaches the app

tasks_completed.description: Added answers field to ToolCall.permission type and permissionAnswersStore for AskUserQuestion persistence
tasks_completed.changes: Added answers?: Record<string,string> to permission type, permissionAnswersStore Map with getPermissionAnswers() in ops.ts, AskUserQuestionView uses fallback from store
tasks_completed.rationale: AskUserQuestion answers were lost on re-render because they came from agentState which gets cleared; now persisted in a local store

tasks_completed.description: Fixed subagent sidebar missing messages by removing isUuidLike check in reducerTracer.ts
tasks_completed.changes: Removed the isUuidLike() check that was treating CUID2 parent references as standalone messages. Now all messages with unprocessed parents are buffered as orphans and flushed when parent arrives.
tasks_completed.rationale: CUID2 subagent IDs (e.g. 'cm...') are not UUID-like but are valid parent references. The old check caused messages with CUID2 parents to be inserted as standalone instead of being buffered for their parent.

tasks_completed.description: Updated SidebarFileView.tsx to display full file content with syntax highlighting and tab switching
tasks_completed.changes: Added File/Diff tab bar that appears when tool.result contains file content (long multiline string from CLI enrichment). File tab shows full content via SimpleSyntaxHighlighter, Diff tab shows the existing old_string->new_string diff view. Default tab is File when content is available.
tasks_completed.rationale: The CLI now injects full file content into tool-call-end output for Edit/Write tools. The sidebar needs to display this content alongside the diff view.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - new features and bug fixes
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Issue 1: CLI did not include file content in tool-call-end. Issue 2: AskUserQuestion answers were in agentState which gets cleared. Issue 3: isUuidLike check assumed all parent IDs were UUID format but subagents use CUID2.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Issue 1: CLI reads file after Edit/Write and injects into envelope; app displays with syntax highlighting. Issue 2: Local store persists answers independently of agentState. Issue 3: All non-matching parent references are now orphan-buffered.
